articles.title: Whitby pedestrian, 35, in critical condition after getting hit by car

articles.title: Mississauga rock band Billy Talent recognized for support of mental health charity
articles.summary: Mississauga's punk rock band Billy Talent received an award from the Mississauga Arts Council this week, acknowledging the band's work outside of music. They have supported mental health charity Make Music Matter for 15 years, which uses songwriting as a therapeutic tool to help empower and heal. CBC Peel host Nav Nanwa has the story.

articles.title: Two more suspects charged in Scarborough murder investigation
articles.summary: One of Canada’s most wanted fugitives has been arrested in connection with a months-long murder investigation. Toronto police said 25-year-old Devondre Hall was taken into custody on Friday and charged with first-degree murder in connection with the violent death of 32-year-old Marcus Charles. Charles was found dead inside a burning vehicle at approximately 11:30 p.m. […]

articles.summary: Toronto police arrested a driver after a single-vehicle crash north of The Junction early Saturday morning. articles.summary: A Toronto man was arrested Friday in connection with a break-in that occurred in East York earlier this month, according to police. articles.title: Staples Canada says customer information accessed in data breach
articles.summary: RICHMOND HILL — Staples Canada says hackers accessed customer information in a cyberattack this month.

articles.title: Stellantis would owe feds $831M if sale of Brampton, Ont., plant proceeds: source
articles.summary: The projected amount of money Stellantis would owe Ottawa should the sale of its Brampton, Ont., auto plant proceed is $831 million, a senior federal source tells CBC News.

articles.title: Child attacked by coyote at Edwards Gardens in Toronto, police say
articles.summary: Police are warning the public after a coyote attacked a child in a northeast Toronto park this week.

articles.title: Nikhil Gupta sentenced to over 19 years in prison for plot to kill U.S.-Canadian activist
articles.summary: An Indian man was sentenced to more than 19 years in prison in a federal court in New York on Friday after admitting guilt in a plot to kill dual U.S.-Canadian citizen Gurpatwant Pannun.

articles.title: Ford Motor Co. officially producing Super Duty trucks at Oakville, Ont., assembly plant after retool
articles.summary: Ford Motor Co. is betting its Oakville, Ont., assembly complex can help the company drive growth and demonstrate the automaker's commitment to Canadian manufacturing for the long haul.

articles.title: 60-year-old driver charged after crash that killed pedestrian in August: Durham police
articles.summary: On Aug. 18, officers responded after a man on rollerblades was struck by a transport truck driven by a 60-year-old man in Ajax, Ont., Durham police said. Three months later, the driver has been charged with careless driving causing death.
